name: pico
description: A local desktop workspace for Oh My Pi

scripts.icon: swift scripts/make-icon.swift && iconutil -c icns build/Pico.iconset -o assets/Pico.icns && cp build/Pico.iconset/icon_512x512@2x.png assets/Pico.png
scripts.package: npm run icon && npm run build && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
